{{Infobox |eng = Dragon Tooth |source = [[Volcano Dungeon]] • [[Stingray]] [[Fish Pond]] |sellprice = 500 |quality = false }} The '''Dragon Tooth''' is a special item that can be obtained in the [[Volcano Dungeon]] within the skeletal remains of a dragon or by killing a [[Lava Lurk]] (15% drop chance). They can also be acquired from a [[Stingray]] [[Fish Pond]] with a population of at least 9. Five Dragon Teeth can be used to purchase a [[Banana Sapling]] from the [[Island Trader]].
